name: anim_jyu_slam_crouch
subject: a huge, heavy bear man made of glossy brown paint with messy cream splotches and a big round belly
desc: He drops his hips low into a deep wide crouch, knees bending wide apart, fists clenching, the heavy body tensing and gathering power. The face keeps the same thick angular eyebrows, half-lidded eyes and closed mouth. Thick, sticky, viscous paint.
